name: cl_fvg_oside_15_mid_r1_t2_gap0p1_es

source.title: Claude 2026-10-20: the same open-side FVG 15m rule on ES (a neighbour market, not a pick)

entry.words: Above the 09:30 open: a limit at the near edge of the most recent 15-minute up fair value gap; below the open: the most recent down gap. Stop at the middle candle's extreme, target 1:1. Up to two trades per session pass.

taught: [chat 2026-10-19] above the 09:30 open: longs on the most recent FVG; below: shorts
[chat 2026-10-19] stop at the middle candle's extreme; owner: run the same rule at 1:1
[Claude 2026-10-20] gaps at least 0.1 x ATR(14) high; two a day
not_run: THE CAP: two a day (one instance for the whole window).
GAP SIZE: at least 0.1 x ATR(14) of the 15-minute bars.
SIDE: price vs the 09:30 open is read on each 5-minute close, not tick by tick. Claude's pick.
THE ENTRY: a limit at the gap's near edge, the usual FVG retest; a newer gap or a flip of the side moves the order.
WINDOW: entries 09:30-15:00, an unfilled order cancelled at 15:00.
GAP SIZE: any gap of one tick or more.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ: build days only.
A stop floor of 0.25 x ATR applies when the candle's extreme is nearer than that.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days).
